label: Zisa OP151S GPON SFP ONT
description: mini-GPON ONT in an SFP module (Lantiq PEB98035, 64 MB (Nanya NT5TU32M16FG-AC1) RAM / 8 MB (GigaDevice GD25Q64CW16) flash, eCoS) that presents to the host as 2.5G Ethernet; GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up on sc-apc with no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over web UI + SSH + serial.
